_purpose: Metadata for evaluation/annotation/rc2_rc3_relationships_blind.json (the sample annotators were given) and rc2_rc3_relationships_answer_key.json (SMRITI's own predictions for the same sample, used for scoring, never shown to annotators before their judgment). RECTIFIED (external "reality check" review round 3, P0-10/P1 annotation metadata) -- this file did not exist before this pass; fields are back-filled from what is genuinely recoverable, with honest nulls elsewhere rather than fabricated values.
protocol_version_note: The protocol version in effect when this sample was drawn and annotated, not the current protocol.md version (2.0) -- this round predates the v2.0 axis-based direction/EQUIVALENT-strengthening schema formalization and used the compound A_CONFIRMS_B/B_CONFIRMS_A direction labels score.py now maps onto the A_TO_B/B_TO_A axis internally.
source_run_id_note: The Phase 6 pipeline run whose candidate pairs and raw NLI scores this 228-pair sample was drawn from. Recorded per-entry in rc2_rc3_relationships_answer_key.json's own source_run_id field, which is where this value is copied from.
sample_seed_note: Not recorded at sampling time. The stratified sampling procedure (every candidate pair touching a deliberately-contradictory document plus a stratified sample of other predicted types) is described in paper/sections/annotation_protocol.tex, but no RNG seed was captured for the specific draw, so the exact 228-pair sample cannot be mechanically reproduced from a seed alone -- only reconstructed from the blind/answer-key files themselves, which are retained for exactly this reason.

predictions_rederived.reason: A further external review found and fixed resolver-level bugs (retired no-entailment REFINES heuristic, directional-confidence fix, specificity-gate attribution-cue fix) after this sample was originally scored. predicted_label/direction/calibrated_confidence in rc2_rc3_relationships_answer_key.json were regenerated from the SAME cached raw NLI scores (no re-inference -- the model and its inputs are unchanged, only how the scores are resolved is), so this is a like-for-like re-scoring of the identical sample, not a new draw.

blind_status_note: rc2_rc3_relationships_blind.json (given to annotators) never included SMRITI's predicted_label/direction/confidence fields -- confirmed by inspecting the file's own schema (relationship_id, claim_a_text, claim_a_doc, claim_b_text, claim_b_doc only).
